g.text: SKILL 5 OF 5 · §2.5 PAPER2REEL
Paper2Reel is a presentation surface, not a fourth summary: one alignmentsidecar makes four artifacts views of one section
Figure 9: hover highlights a section; double-click opens video, captions, thumbnails, and the aligned blog passage
FIG. 9
INTERACTION DESIGN
Poster-first: the first screen is the generated poster, not adashboard
Hover feedback; double-click opens the section modal — video left,blog right, draggable splitter
Playback uses the subtitle-free source; captions come fromsidecars behind the viewer's toggle
Slide thumbnails seek to their time; the title area opens a full-papermodal; EN / 中文 switch in the header
CONTENT ALIGNMENT

The alignment sidecar maps each canonical section id to its poster block, one or more slide targets,video start and end, subtitle tracks, thumbnails, and blog blocks; the viewer never scrapes filenames,the poster, or the video
On a PDF, an arXiv link, or a partial bundle, missing upstream stages are completed through the fullworkflows, preserving section ids and asset paths
Root: the viewer page, the alignment record, the manifest; poster, media, slides, blog, and downloads intheir own folders; native files stay downloadable
VALIDATED AS AN INTERACTIVE ARTIFACT

Static gate: viewer, alignment record, manifest, copied poster assets, media, slide frames, blog blocks,wordmark, downloads all present; no stale tabbed-viewer markers, machine-local paths, or backup files; rawpre-subtitle video as playback source

Browser gate: served with a range-capable local server (seeking and thumbnail jumps need partial-contentresponses); headless checks of poster-first load, hover, both modals, split pane, subtitle toggle, thumbnailand direct seeking, menu, downloads, shortcuts, blog rendering
A separate file-browser gate confirms the page also opens directly from disk
Bundle root, kept to three files
The interactive viewer page, the alignment record, and thepackage manifest; poster, media, slides, blog, and downloads sitin their own folders and stay downloadable as native files.
Source: arXiv:2607.04438 v2 (19 Jul 2026)
